answer.reason: Engedi is where David took refuge from Saul and where a great host came against Jehoshaphat, so events of the story happened there.

clauses.english: was where David dwelt in strong holds when Saul pursued him
clauses.quote: David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.

clauses.english: was where a great multitude from Moab and Ammon came against Jehoshaphat
clauses.quote: they be in Hazazontamar, which is Engedi.

doubts: Song of Solomon 1:14 only uses Engedi's vineyards in a comparison, and Joshua 15:62 only lists it among cities, so both were left out.
Ezekiel 47:10 is a vision of the future and is already reflected in the summary, so it was not used.
